outcome: Treatment outcomes of cesarean scar pregnancy
cohort: 5 cases of cesarean scar pregnancy diagnosed and managed at a tertiary care center over a 3-year period.
finding: The study suggests that systemic intramuscular methotrexate may not be the optimal first-line treatment for cesarean scar pregnancy, while intra-gestational sac treatment may lead to persistent retained products of conception and vaginal spotting, potentially manageable with ultrasound-guided dilation and curettage.
